results.question: How many films are in the database?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many actors are in the database?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS actor_count FROM actor LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many customers are there in total?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM customer LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many films have the rating R?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS r_film_count FROM film WHERE rating = 'R' LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many films are there for each rating? Show the rating and the count.
results.sql: SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS count FROM film GROUP BY rating LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is the average rental rate across all films?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(rental_rate) AS average_rental_rate FROM film LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is the length in minutes of the longest film?
results.sql: SELECT MAX(length) AS longest_length FROM film LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many films are longer than 150 minutes?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE length > 150 LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many film categories are there?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS category_count FROM category LIMIT 1000

results.question: List the names of all film categories.
results.sql: SELECT name FROM category LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many cities are in the database?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS city_count FROM city LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many payments have been made in total?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_payments FROM payment LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is the total amount of all payments?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_payments FROM payment LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many rentals have not been returned yet?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS not_returned_count FROM rental WHERE return_date IS NULL LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many films have a replacement cost above 25?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 25 LIMIT 1000

results.question: For each store that has customers, how many customers does it have? Show the store id and the count.
results.sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer GROUP BY store_id LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many films are in each category? Show the category name and the number of films.
results.sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(fc.film_id) AS film_count FROM category AS c JOIN film_category AS fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many films are there in each language? Show the language name and the count, and only include languages that have at least one film.
results.sql: SELECT l.name, COUNT(f.film_id) AS film_count FROM language AS l JOIN film AS f ON f.language_id = l.language_id GROUP BY l.name HAVING COUNT(f.film_id) > 0 LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is the total payment amount handled by each staff member? Show first name, last name and the total.
results.sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total FROM payment AS p JOIN staff AS s ON p.staff_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many rentals were made in each year? Show the year as a number and the count.
results.sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM rental_date) AS INT) AS year, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 1000

results.question: What was the total payment revenue in each month of 2025? Show the month number (1-12) and the total.
results.sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM payment_date) AS INT) AS month, SUM(amount) AS total_revenue FROM payment WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM payment_date) = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 1000

results.question: Which country has the most cities? Show the country name and its number of cities.
results.sql: SELECT c.country AS country_name, COUNT(ci.city_id) AS city_count FROM country AS c JOIN city AS ci ON ci.country_id = c.country_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY city_count DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many customers have an address in India?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer AS c JOIN address AS a ON c.address_id = a.address_id JOIN city AS ci ON a.city_id = ci.city_id JOIN country AS co ON ci.country_id = co.country_id WHERE co.country = 'India' LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is the average film length for each rating? Show the rating and the average length.
results.sql: SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS average_length FROM film GROUP BY rating LIMIT 1000

results.question: Which 5 customers have spent the most in total? Show first name, last name and total spent.
results.sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent FROM payment AS p JOIN customer AS c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: How many inventory copies does each store hold? Show the store id and the count, only for stores that have inventory.
results.sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS inventory_count FROM inventory GROUP BY store_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many films has the actor PENELOPE GUINESS appeared in?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM actor AS a JOIN film_actor AS fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id WHERE a.first_name = 'PENELOPE' AND a.last_name = 'GUINESS' LIMIT 1000

results.question: List the titles of films in the Horror category that are rated R.
results.sql: SELECT f.title FROM film AS f JOIN film_category AS fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN "category" AS c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Horror' AND f.rating = 'R' LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many rentals did each staff member process? Show first name, last name and the count.
results.sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM staff AS s JOIN rental AS r ON s.staff_id = r.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id, s.first_name, s.last_name LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many distinct customers rented at least one film in 2024?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM rental WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM rental_date) = 2024 LIMIT 1000

results.question: Which film category has the highest average replacement cost? Show the category name and the average.
results.sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, AVG(f.replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost FROM category AS c JOIN film_category AS fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film AS f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY avg_replacement_cost DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: How many customers signed up in each year? Show the year as a number and the count.
results.sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM create_date) AS INT) AS year, COUNT(*) AS count FROM customer GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is the total amount paid by the customer with customer id 1?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM payment WHERE customer_id = 1 LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many films have no actors listed?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS films_without_actors FROM film LEFT JOIN film_actor ON film.film_id = film_actor.film_id WHERE film_actor.actor_id IS NULL LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is the average rental rate of films in each category? Show the category name and the average.
results.sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(f.rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate FROM category AS c JOIN film_category AS fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film AS f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY c.name LIMIT 1000

results.question: What are the top 5 film categories by total payment revenue? Show the category name and the revenue.
results.sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN film_category AS fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category AS c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: List the titles of films that have never been rented.
results.sql: SELECT f.title FROM film AS f WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id) LIMIT 1000

results.question: For each film category, what is the average rental length in days, measured as return date minus rental date as a fractional number of days, counting only returned rentals? Show the category name and the average.
results.sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.return_date - r.rental_date)) / 86400) AS avg_days FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN film_category AS fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category AS c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.name LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many customers have a total payment amount greater than the average total payment amount per customer?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) AS cust_totals WHERE total > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM (SELECT SUM(amount) AS total FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id) AS avg_totals) LIMIT 1000

results.question: Which 5 actors appear in films that generated the most total payment revenue? Show first name, last name and revenue.
results.sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN film_actor AS fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id JOIN actor AS a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: Among returned rentals, what percentage were returned late, meaning the time between rental date and return date was longer than the film's rental_duration in days?
results.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date > r.rental_date + CAST((f.rental_duration || ' days') AS INTERVAL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS late_percentage FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON i.film_id = f.film_id LIMIT 1000

results.question: For each month of 2025, how many distinct customers made at least one payment? Show the month number and the count.
results.sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM payment_date) AS INT) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM payment WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM payment_date) = 2025 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is the highest total amount that any single customer paid during 2025?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM payment WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM payment_date) = 2025 GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Which 3 film categories have the most rentals? Show the category name and the number of rentals.
results.sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN film_category AS fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category AS c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY rental_count DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: What is the total payment revenue for each store, based on which store the rented copy belongs to? Show the store id and the revenue.
results.sql: SELECT i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id GROUP BY i.store_id ORDER BY i.store_id LIMIT 1000

results.question: Which films were rented more than 95 times? Show the title and the number of rentals.
results.sql: SELECT f.title, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM film AS f JOIN inventory AS i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental AS r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY f.title HAVING COUNT(r.rental_id) > 95 LIMIT 1000

results.question: For each month of 2025, what was the change in total payment revenue compared with the previous month of 2025? Show the month number and the change, with no value for January.
results.sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM payment_date) AS INT) AS month, SUM(amount) AS total FROM payment WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM payment_date) = 2025 GROUP BY month) SELECT month, total - LAG(total) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change FROM monthly ORDER BY month LIMIT 1000

results.question: What percentage of total payment revenue comes from films of each rating? Show the rating and the percentage.
results.sql: SELECT f.rating, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(p.amount) / SUM(SUM(p.amount)) OVER (), 2) AS percentage FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many customers have rented at least one film from every film category?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT r.customer_id FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category AS fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id GROUP BY r.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fc.category_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category)) AS sub LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many actors have appeared in films of all five MPAA ratings?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS actor_count FROM (SELECT fa.actor_id FROM film_actor AS fa JOIN film AS f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY fa.actor_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.rating) = 5) AS sub LIMIT 1000

results.question: What's the weather in Delhi today?
results.sql: SELECT NULL LIMIT 1000

results.question: Delete all rentals.
results.sql: SELECT rental_id FROM rental LIMIT 1000

results.question: Update the rental rate of every film to 0.99.
results.sql: SELECT 'Update not allowed in read‑only mode' AS message LIMIT 1000

results.question: Drop the customer table.
results.sql: SELECT 1 LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is each customer's credit card number?
results.sql: SELECT NULL AS credit_card_number FROM customer LIMIT 0

results.question: How many employees does Netflix have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM staff LIMIT 1000

results.question: Which films won an Oscar?
results.sql: SELECT film.title FROM film WHERE FALSE LIMIT 1000

results.question: What will total revenue be next year?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_revenue_next_year FROM payment WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM payment_date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) + 1 LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many VIP customers do we have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS vip_customer_count FROM customer WHERE activebool = TRUE LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is our late return rate?
results.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date IS NOT NULL AND r.return_date > r.rental_date + (f.rental_duration * INTERVAL '1 DAY') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(*) AS late_return_rate FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON i.film_id = f.film_id LIMIT 1000

results.question: What is our average order value?
results.sql: SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_order_value FROM payment LIMIT 1000

results.question: What was our catalog utilization in 2025?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rentals_2025 FROM rental WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM rental_date) = 2025 LIMIT 1000

results.question: What was our customer retention rate from 2024 to 2025?
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN total = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(CAST(retained AS DECIMAL) / total, 4) END AS retention_rate FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM customer WHERE create_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31') AS t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS retained FROM customer AS c WHERE c.create_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE r.customer_id = c.customer_id AND r.rental_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31')) AS r LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many churned customers do we have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS churned_customers FROM customer WHERE activebool = FALSE LIMIT 1000

results.question: Which film category is our best performer?
results.sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM category AS c JOIN film_category AS fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film AS f ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN inventory AS i ON f.film_id = i.film_id JOIN rental AS r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY rental_count DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What was our revenue per active title in 2025?
results.sql: SELECT f.title, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM film AS f JOIN inventory AS i ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.rental_date) = 2025 GROUP BY f.title LIMIT 1000

results.question: How many dormant titles do we have?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS dormant_titles FROM film AS f WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inventory AS i JOIN rental AS r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE i.film_id = f.film_id) LIMIT 1000

results.question: What was our year-over-year revenue growth in 2025?
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN prev_year_rev = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST((curr_year_rev - prev_year_rev) AS DECIMAL) / prev_year_rev * 100 END AS yoy_growth_percent FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM payment_date) = 2025 THEN amount END) AS curr_year_rev, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM payment_date) = 2024 THEN amount END) AS prev_year_rev FROM payment) AS sub LIMIT 1000
